entries.09249a4af7c0b316: A company based in Shizuoka Prefecture engaged in a wide range of businesses, including vehicle sales, manufacture and sale of industrial machinery, and sales of electrical equipment.
entries.0dcbc86c523021a0: Manufacturers using parts for machine tools, automobiles, industrial machinery and others.

entries.2ae54ba38e986e28: A business in which the company and its consolidated subsidiaries Shizuoka Subaru Jidosha Co., Ltd., Shizuoka V-Auto Co., Ltd., PUREST Co., Ltd. and Cool the Earth Co., Ltd. sell vehicles and related products mainly in Shizuoka Prefecture. It provides services such as sales of new and used Subaru vehicles and vehicle inspection and maintenance, and sells imported vehicles. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥24,959 million, the largest of the five reportable segments.
entries.46fc2e6e8c130a7f: A business that manufactures and sells packaging machinery products, sterilizing equipment, food processing machinery, industrial machinery and FA production systems, and provides maintenance services. The company manufactures packaging machinery and, except for some products, sells it through consolidated subsidiary Nihon Kikai Shoji Co., Ltd. Consolidated subsidiary Econos Japan Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells sterilizing equipment and food processing machinery, and consolidated subsidiary Kyowa Tech Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial machinery and FA production systems, respectively. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥9,527 million.

entries.8391bbf9b3b3ee44: A business that sells electrical equipment such as FA equipment, air-conditioning equipment, refrigeration equipment and solar power generation equipment, and performs installation work for air-conditioning systems. The company operates mainly in Shizuoka Prefecture. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,706 million.
entries.8d1fe363ecefcb10: A business engaged in real estate leasing, parking operation and car rental. The company leases real estate to subsidiaries and others, and consolidated subsidiary Shizuoka Jidosha Co., Ltd. operates parking and car rental businesses mainly in Shizuoka Prefecture. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥145 million.
